text:
marco: Quick idea — run a small PLG experiment: give a short burst of free credits + tailored prompt templates + an in-app activation nudge for users who show high intent but haven't converted. Goal: move them to ‘activated’ within 48h.

ellie: Sounds promising. Which segment exactly?

marco: Segment = users who made >=2 generation calls OR >=3 embeddings in a 24h window, but no return in 7 days. Also include new orgs with low seats.

jen: Baseline conversion for that cohort is ~12% to activation (last 30d). Power calc: to detect a +4pp lift at 80% we need ~7k users total across arms. Can we target that audience in a 2-week window?

ali: We can. Onboarding can show a mini flow after credit grant: 30s walkthrough + 1-click sample prompt. We'll need an API endpoint to grant credits and flag the user for the nudge.

marco: Plan 4 arms: control, credit-only (100 tokens), credit+prompt-templates, credit+prompt+onboarding nudge. Attribution window 7 days. Primary metric: activation within 48h. Secondary: retention 7d.

sasha: I can produce 3 microcopy variants and 2 creative banners for the in-app nudge. Sample copy idea: "Try a guided prompt — we added 100 free tokens to your account." Will mock by EOD. :art: 

jen: Tracking: add `experiment_id=exp-2026-03-credit-nudge` to events, and use cohort table + funnel query. I'll add a dashboard and calc for lift, p-values, and cost per incremental activation.

ali: Backend notes: we already have `POST /admin/grant_credit` for internal ops. For experiment we'll call `POST /exp/grant` that writes to experiments table. Payload example: 
```
POST /exp/grant
{
  "user_id": "U12345",
  "exp_id": "exp-2026-03-credit-nudge",
  "arm": "credit+prompt",
  "credits": 100
}
```
We should rate-limit and put a retry for idempotency.

marco: Can marketing own the comms? short email + in-app nudge + one push (if enabled). Suggest email template + 1 subject A/B.

ellie: Yep. I'll draft 2 subject lines and the email body. Also want to route inbound responses to growth inbox. Add UTM params: `utm_campaign=credit-nudge-2026` so sales can see high-intent replies.

jen: Funnel routing note — flag users who convert as leads with `lead_score += 10` and forward to inbound-sales webhook. We'll include `lead_reason=credit-nudge` in payload.

marco: Budget check — estimated cost = avg token cost * expected redemptions. If 7k users * 60% redeem * 100 tokens = 420k tokens. Rough cost ~= $X (will calc). If cost-per-incremental-activation < CAC threshold, we scale.

sasha: Mockups: will post Figma link later. For now attaching hero copy: "Hands-on AI: 100 free tokens to test prompts that ship value" :rocket:

growth-bot: Experiment created: id=exp-2026-03-credit-nudge, start=1769508000, end=1769712000, arms=4. Tracking channel #growth-experiments.

ali: Next steps: 1) copy & assets from marketing (ellie/sasha), 2) backend endpoint + QA (eng), 3) analytics dashboard + queries (jen), 4) rollout plan and guardrails (marco). Can we target a 2-week launch?

ellie: Yes — aiming to launch next Tues. I'll post the email + in-app copy tomorrow for review. :eyes:

marco: Awesome. If anyone sees edge cases (org billing, existing credits, promo conflicts) flag them here. Otherwise tagging folks: @jen @ali @sasha @ellie.

jen: flag — exclude users who used a promo in last 30d to avoid stacking.

ali: noted. Also add a fallback in case grant fails: deliver a one-time promo code via email so UX isn't broken.

sasha: I'll design a small badge that shows "100 free tokens" on the nudge.

marco: Great — check-ins Fri for status. :calendar:
